text:
Alex: OK folks — starting a quick thread to align on a 'small-batch' design partner pilot playbook. Goal: recruit 8–12 micro cohorts (2-week), validate onboarding friction and prompt template quality and gather rapid feedback. I sketched a minimum playbook below.

Priya: love it. main q: incentives? cash vs credits vs research perks?

Alex: leaning credits + a 1:1 research session + an early-access badge. small stipend for the very first cohort to ensure commitment. thoughts?

Sam: prefer credits for scaling. stipend reserved for high-effort cohorts (complex integration). also recommend a 3-touch outreach funnel: email -> in-app -> AE call. keep outreach short.

Jorge: success criteria proposal: activation within 48h >= 50%, weekly retention >= 30% at week 2, NPS >= 8 for engaged participants. plus: at least 3 triaged product issues and 1 notable prompt-regression reported per cohort.

Maya: I can run recruiting. can we target PLG signups with certain usage signals + a small enterprise DP list? i'll need the final invite copy and a segmentation query.

Leah: tracking notes — we need explicit event names and a cohort tag in Amplitude. also enable a per-cohort feature flag so we can roll changes. dashboard in Console to show activation/latency/cost per cohort.

Alex: sample invite to copy/adapt: 
```
Subject: Join a 2-week Redwood pilot — credits + 1:1 research session
Hi <Name>,
We’re running a short pilot to improve inference latency and cost for <use_case>.
Commitment: 2 weeks, ~3 short sessions, quick feedback forms + an optional 1:1.
Reward: $200 credit + early access and a 1:1 with the product team.
Reply if interested or click here: <signup link>.
```

Priya: add one line asking them to paste their top 2 prompts / workloads in the signup form. helps eval and privacy checks.

Jorge: evaluation checklist idea: baseline throughput & per-token cost, example outputs before/after model/config change, qualitative notes, and a pass/fail gating for rollout.

Maya: rough timeline: recruit this week, kickoff next Mon, 2-week pilot, wrap + debrief week after. is that doable?

ops-bot: calendar created: 'Small-Batch Pilot Kickoff' Mon 10:00 — invites sent to owners.

Sam: proposed feedback loop: daily short async logs in Notion (bullet points), weekly 30m sync with cohort lead, structured survey at day 3 and day 14, and an end-of-pilot 1:1 to surface qualitative insights. assign an SE/host for each cohort.

Leah: tagging convention suggestion: cohort_smallbatch_{id}. Event props: cohort_source, incentive_type, dp_label, candidate_tier. we'll document in the analytics runbook.

Alex: owner assignments: recruiting -> Maya, analytics/dashboard -> Leah, outreach copy -> Priya, ops/runbooks -> Sam, lead PM -> Alex, eng oncall contact -> Jorge.

Maya: ok i'll post an initial list of ~30 candidates and priority funnel by EOD. :raised_hands:

Priya: i'll draft the email + in-app copy today and ping for reviews.

Jorge: add a quick QC checklist for prompt sets: PII redaction, sample size >= 5 prompts, and a log retention policy for the pilot data.

Alex: agreed on QC and privacy. we'll keep logs short-lived and anonymize examples in writeups. next sync Wed 9:00am. Thanks all! :rocket:
